description: On Thursday, October 3rd, Ivan Posey will be in Atlantic City to meet you and answer your questions about his candidacy for the Wyoming Legislature HD 33. This Meet and Greet will start at 6 PM and will be at the St. Andrew’s Church Community Room, 50 E. Forbes St., Atlantic City.
title: Ivan Posey Meet and Greet in Atlantic City — Ivan Posey for House District 33
